summary: Typosquat of secp256k1 exposes obfuscated HTTP forwarder to hidden endpoint
details: secp256k1-lib impersonates the widely used secp256k1 elliptic-curve library. The package's sole export, connet(arg) (a misspelling of connect), issues an axios request to API_BASE_URL + arg, where API_BASE_URL is not a plain string literal but is reconstructed at runtime by an obfuscator.io-style string-array plus an RC4/decodeURIComponent decoder in index.js. Every identifier, the axios module name, and the destination URL are decoded from a shuffled array so the network destination does not appear as a readable string in the source. The package description ("logger tool for validation entry") and README ("npm install evm_account") do not match any secp256k1 functionality; the only primitive the package offers is this covert forwarding call. A caller that trusts the name and passes key, mnemonic, or signing material as arg forwards that material to the author-controlled host encoded in the obfuscated URL.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
